description: This Java class 'TenantRepo' manages tenant-related data, including entities, relations, and event processing within the Thingsboard platform. It handles adding, updating, removing entities and relations, and supports querying entity data with sorting and pagination.

classes.name: TenantRepo
classes.description: Manages tenant-specific entities, relations, and event processing, providing querying and data management functionalities within the platform.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes an EdqsEvent, updating or removing objects accordingly.

methods.name: addOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds or updates an EdqsObject based on its type.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an EdqsObject based on its type.

methods.name: addOrUpdateRelation
methods.description: Adds or updates an EntityRelation, managing relation repositories.

methods.name: removeRelation
methods.description: Removes an EntityRelation from relation repositories.

methods.name: addOrUpdateEntity
methods.description: Adds or updates an Entity, managing entity data and customer associations.

methods.name: removeEntity
methods.description: Removes an Entity and updates related data structures.

methods.name: addOrUpdateAttribute
methods.description: Adds or updates an attribute key-value for an entity.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute key-value from an entity.

methods.name: addOrUpdateLatestKv
methods.description: Adds or updates a latest timestamp key-value for an entity.

methods.name: removeLatestKv
methods.description: Removes a latest timestamp key-value from an entity.

methods.name: getEntityMap
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the entity map for a specific EntityType.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves or creates EntityData for a given EntityId or EntityType and UUID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves EntityData for a given EntityId or EntityType and UUID.

methods.name: constructEntityData
methods.description: Constructs a new EntityData instance based on EntityType and UUID.

methods.name: entityIdMismatch
methods.description: Checks if two UUIDs differ, indicating a mismatch.

methods.name: getEntitySet
methods.description: Returns the set of EntityData objects for a specific EntityType.

methods.name: findEntityDataByQuery
methods.description: Executes a query to find entity data, returning paginated results.

methods.name: countEntitiesByQuery
methods.description: Counts entities matching a query.

methods.name: sortAndConvert
methods.description: Sorts and paginates entity data based on query parameters.

methods.name: toQueryResult
methods.description: Converts sorted entity data into QueryResult objects.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Builds a QueryContext for querying entities.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the TenantId associated with this repository.

methods.name: getRelations
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a RelationsRepo for a given RelationTypeGroup.

methods.name: getOwnerEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the owner entity based on EntityId.
